visual.scope: Visual-only local verification-card fixture; no authentication or email delivery is claimed.

build.note: Rebuilt after the final dark-mode link contrast adjustment; existing Vite chunk-size advisory remains.

dataBoundary: Only isolated demo-campusvibe-feed Auth/Firestore emulators, fictional inboxes and existing guest sample data. No production accounts created, existing users auto-verified, reviewer roles changed, provider uploads or real verification emails sent.
expected: Member features require a strictly verified email. Syntax alone does not establish that an inbox exists or belongs to the user.
behavior: Signup creates a pending account and requests Firebase verification; access stays blocked until the link is applied.
Existing unverified email login and restored sessions are also gated.
Resend has a one-minute local cooldown and displays Firebase throttling/network failures.
Checking verification reloads the user and refreshes the ID token before restoring the original destination.
Firestore member checks and photo/AI account lookup checks independently require verification.
Verified Google email claims remain eligible; this is not a new real Google account-login result.
Different-email action signs out; no account or saved data is deleted.

steps: Use a dedicated empty local Firebase demo project. Start auth/firestore with backend/firebase/firebase.json and project demo-campusvibe-feed.
Start npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort with the VITE emulator environment above.
Run npm run test:rules and npm run test:backend from the repository root.
Run npm run test:email-verification --workspace frontend/react-app, then npm run test:email-verification-browser --workspace frontend/react-app with the explicit test environment above.
For UI regressions run the smoke specs listed below and npm run build.
repeat.helper: tests/verify-emulator-email.js applies only a locally issued OOB verification code, refuses production URLs/project IDs, and uses the actual SDK verification check; it does not bypass the gate.

limitations: No real mailbox delivery/receipt is certified; a user must open their actual verification email after deployment.
No new Google identity selection/session proof, independent teammate test or personal source explain-back.
Provider calls in API tests use fixtures; the visual card screenshots are explicitly static UI fixtures.
Live deployment and exact rules-source verification are recorded separately in Issue #170.
preservation: All docs/, README and .github files are unchanged.
